I have completed the task to add path prefix support in HTTP method patterns across [`Handle`](file:///private/var/folders/3q/2m8v425s7p39t7qxjp0kcdw80000gn/T/parbench-host-ku6zycm1/repo/mux.go#L109-L112) and [`HandleFunc`](file:///private/var/folders/3q/2m8v425s7p39t7qxjp0kcdw80000gn/T/parbench-host-ku6zycm1/repo/mux.go#L114-L119).

### Changes Made:
1. **Extracted and Unified Pattern Parsing**:
   - In [mux.go](file:///private/var/folders/3q/2m8v425s7p39t7qxjp0kcdw80000gn/T/parbench-host-ku6zycm1/repo/mux.go#L121-L136), introduced a helper method `(*Mux).parsePattern(pattern string) (methodTyp, string)` that handles both standard path patterns (e.g. `/path`, `/path/*`) and method-prefixed patterns (e.g. `METHOD /path`, `METHOD /path/*`).
   - Updated both [`Handle`](file:///private/var/folders/3q/2m8v425s7p39t7qxjp0kcdw80000gn/T/parbench-host-ku6zycm1/repo/mux.go#L109) and [`HandleFunc`](file:///private/var/folders/3q/2m8v425s7p39t7qxjp0kcdw80000gn/T/parbench-host-ku6zycm1/repo/mux.go#L116) to use `parsePattern`, ensuring consistent behavior between both methods.

2. **Added Tests**:
   - In [mux_test.go](file:///private/var/folders/3q/2m8v425s7p39t7qxjp0kcdw80000gn/T/parbench-host-ku6zycm1/repo/mux_test.go#L643), updated `TestMuxHandlePatternValidation` to test both `Handle` and `HandleFunc`, including wildcard prefix patterns like `GET /api/v1/*` and `POST /api/v1/*`.
   - Verified that the full test suite passes.
